g.text: UC3 - View a country profile with the time series of its indicators
- country list (ISO3 code, name) already loaded
- period from 1975 to the latest available year
(click on the map or search by name)
Add this country to a comparison?
Send the request to the controller
Show an error message with a retry button
and all line charts side by side
and one chart at a time
(aggregates such as WLD are not stored)
- one time series per Indicator (year, value, unit)
- indicators without any value marked "No data"
Load the Country (name, region, income group)
to the latest available year, for every Indicator
